tasks.description: The rebuild contract: the 'Phone app rebuild (from 2026-10-07)' section in CLAUDE.md, word for word from the Notion Phase 0 page.
Control files: docs/rebuild/state.md, archive.md, feature_list.json, stack.md, streamlit_bound_tests.md, owner_checks.json, p0_proof.json, handoff/.
scripts/rebuild_gate.py (counters, HTML + JSON report, --update-features) and tests/test_rebuild_gate.py.
M1: requirements-engine.txt and -dev.txt (exact pins); the suite passes in .venv-engine (Python 3.12) with the Streamlit tests excluded.
M2: api/healthapi with GET /api/health and GET /api/readiness (caller's date, the Home-card computation), X-Engine-Key auth, one Repository per request, cache rebuilt at startup; tests/api/.
M3: Dockerfile (python 3.12 slim, OS tzdata, non-root), .dockerignore, .gcloudignore as an allow-list; the Cloud Build upload list holds no personal file.
app/ placeholder (Health + version line) and worker/ (Hono: assets, access key, pass-through with X-Engine-Key, JSON 503) with Worker and app tests; shared/openapi.json and generated TS types.
STOP 1, owner: Google Cloud CLI, billing, EUR 1 budget alert, the two Secret Manager secrets, wrangler login, the phone access key in .env.
M4: Cloud Run service health-engine (min 0, max 1 instance), secrets mounted, cache mode, TZ; Artifact Registry clean-up and a 7-day rule on the source bucket.
M7: the Worker deployed as 'health' with ACCESS_KEY, ENGINE_KEY and ENGINE_URL secrets; the placeholder opens on the iPhone.
M5: five forced cold starts, end to end through the Worker and direct, with the engine's own startup timings.
M6: the read-only Oura probe (no refresh, ever) and, with the owner's OK, one Garmin login and read from Cloud Run.
M8: billable time and requests from Cloud Monitoring, projected to a month against each free-tier figure.
No secret-shaped string in any tracked file.
After the owner's push, the hosted Streamlit app still opens.
